findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.affected_population_system: Nutrition service capacity and food access for children and pregnant/breastfeeding women. OCHA reports 286 operational nutrition sites and approximately 6,660 pregnant and breastfeeding women receiving targeted supplementary feeding. During November 1–15, preventive supplementation reached approximately 158,400 children and 83,800 pregnant and breastfeeding women. These are reported coverage and capacity figures, not evidence of adequate coverage or new site openings.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Currently, 286 nutrition sites are operational across the Gaza Strip
